reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 20. Nay or No: 19. Not Voting: 0. Present or other: 1. Of 39 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 39 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 208 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

Passengers have waited a long time and suffered through countless delays waiting for the completion of the Portal North Bridge. Now, both tracks are operating and ready to serve #NorthJersey. 

READ: https://t.co/JWFvpmz2Sy https://t.co/YkUYELD90E

📍Team Pou Checking In From Portal North Bridge:

One of the most-used rail lines in the nation, the completion of the Portal North Bridge is going to make a huge difference for residents, commuters, and #NorthJersey communities. https://t.co/RdUT1oqPz6

Completing the Portal North Bridge is not only a major achievement, but a testament to when state, federal, and regional partners come together. I am excited to witness this project come to life and look forward to the benefits that it will provide to #NorthJersey.

https://t.co/LWL0iRiBjD
Every generation stands a little taller thanks to the women who came before it. Every day we must strive to continue the good work of these women. https://t.co/rVEBS6ujb3 https://t.co/Ryn5UBPPNd

We had a fabulous time with the #PassaicCounty Section of the National Council of Negro Women, where we celebrated 75 years of impact and recognized the importance of Black women’s leadership in our community. https://t.co/qOA73qMPXx

“So who knew Santa’s workshop is in New Jersey?”

#NJ09 did! And the Ninth District is excited for this year’s Thanksgiving Day Parade 🦃 https://t.co/ziWPf4DpRd

It was so good to join BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Clifton for a beautiful Annakut celebration and to recognize #Diwali

May the light of Diwali continue to bring joy to your homes, and may this new year bring peace and happiness to your families. Happy Diwali! https://t.co/R9znvK0APQ
INSIDER NJ || Pou Statement On FAA Nationwide Ground Stop: https://t.co/WwHa0FboGa https://t.co/rY2QhLz2yX
My statement on the FAA Nationwide Ground Stop as Vice Ranking Member of the Democratic Aviation Subcommittee. https://t.co/L8dvlODciS

Right now, the FAA has issued a nationwide ground-stop on all flights. My office will continue to monitor the situation as it develops.

https://t.co/Na5BpoI3V8

It’s that time again, #NorthJersey!

Before every new Congress, Members choose a office location in #DC so that we’re ready to serve on Day One.

Stay tuned on where we’re heading for the 120th 👀 https://t.co/law9CjQ4dC

Do you need a lift in #Paterson? Well #PassaicCounty MOVE is here to give residents another low-cost option to commute between Paterson, Passaic and Clifton.

To get moving:
✅ Download Passaic County MOVE
✅ Set up your account 
✅ Book your next ride 🚙💨

MOVE is available https://t.co/Hkc0IwI94b
#NewJersey @HouseDemocrats are ready to get to work! It's time to lower costs and bring results home. https://t.co/TkanQKjj9N
This #VeteransDay, the House came together to advance the Major Richard Star Act and honor the brave Americans who have sacrificed so much for our freedoms. https://t.co/M6ICA4UxZ3

For 250 years, generations of Americans have answered the call to serve and I could not be more grateful.

Thank you to our #NewJersey veterans and veterans from across the country for your dedication to our nation 🇺🇸

#VeteransDay https://t.co/fXokuHdDTq

I may be back in DC this #VeteransDay, but I am still thinking about the brave men and women in #NewJersey who served our country faithfully.

Our nation remains forever grateful for your service 🇺🇸 https://t.co/x64Za13CSB

#Hegseth is unfit and unqualified to serve as Secretary of Defense. Period.  

Again, House Republicans choose to shield the #Trump Admin from accountability instead of putting Americans first. https://t.co/wprxsWNjkN

#Trump’s DHS cut corners when expanding its ICE presence, and American lives were lost because of it. This is unacceptable, the time for accountability is now.

READ: https://t.co/lIjm9os7mW https://t.co/OK0Zuur3xs
READ Rep. Nellie Pou Statement on the appointment of Shirley Emehelu as Lt. Governor: https://t.co/GmrVX636Mc

Hegseth has got to go. I think that's something we can all agree on.

Accountability from the #Trump Administration is long overdue. https://t.co/P7ZvWTlknW
Read my statement on @GovSherrillNJ's historic decision for #NewJersey's Lieutenant Governor. https://t.co/tXhecOZNrR

And while we’re at it, let’s stop President #Trump and JD Vance from trading too.

This isn’t a red or blue issue — no elected official should trade stocks. It’s a matter of trust. https://t.co/O5uKi1N2eI

Open enrollment season is officially here, a time where you can shop and decide which health insurance plan is best for you.

To learn more about your options, visit: https://t.co/ToBbSlfHd0 https://t.co/WgajRT2Sd8

The same week that the American people rejected #Trump and his reckless administration, the President promotes the most right-wing member of his team to Chief of Staff.

At every turn, President Trump refuses the will of the people. It’s ridiculous. https://t.co/XoUkDx0ObL

This week marks 15 years since @Paterson_Falls was federally recognized and formally designated as a National Park.

The Great Falls are the pride of #Paterson and a testament to our city's remarkable history. I will never stop fighting to deliver the federal resources this national treasure deserves.

NEW JERSEY DEMOCRATS TO TRUMP: VOTERS HAVE HAD ENOUGH, AND WE’RE READY TO FIGHT BACK.

READ: https://t.co/h8W40FBTCN https://t.co/vTusjncsej

#Voting is one of the most important rights we have as Americans. It gives each of us a voice in shaping our communities and our futures.

Make sure you get out and vote today! https://t.co/mpDl1luRTJ

This week, @GovSherrillNJ and I toured @AccurateBoxCo, a homegrown business right here in #Paterson with a national impact.

READ: https://t.co/D7Db0rUhzB
Read more about the visit: https://t.co/xWw6yGe42T https://t.co/lX5A5Km44P https://t.co/NHJelhp7b2

.@AccurateBoxCo is a great example of a business not only surviving, but thriving here in #NorthJersey. Businesses like this are how we can continue creating jobs and fueling our local economy.

Thank you, @GovSherrillNJ, for joining us in #Paterson! https://t.co/F6dZzWshmh

It has been 100 days since #FIFAWorldCup took center stage in #EastRutherford. I've spent that time reflecting on our major wins, but success should never prevent us from examining what could be done better.

Read my latest report: https://t.co/sk1mP8T2Pl https://t.co/RO9TErMlOM

Both @thearcofnj and @ARCBP are helping people build lives of their own choosing. They give families someone to turn to when the road ahead feels uncertain, especially in the face of #Trump's aggressive and dangerous attacks to health care.

In Congress, I will keep fighting to https://t.co/Vhl5s7igIA

This September, #NewJersey saw a major nor'easter create enormous damage in our state. That is why I'm demanding that President Trump authorize a Major Disaster Declaration, and unlock federal aid for our state. 

READ: https://t.co/MNUglLzQPy https://t.co/n4FEgDyGWx

This October, we recognize #DomesticViolenceAwarenessMonth and stand in solidarity with survivors 💜 
https://t.co/0kXWLGf7KP

Congressman Pascrell was a #Paterson man through and through, and I am so happy that we were able to honor his legacy.

https://t.co/61ub6Y723c

Too many families struggle to put food on the table. 

Father English has long understood the value of treating those in need with dignity. I am beyond happy to see their newly renovated space come to life and be ready to serve our #Paterson community.

READ:

Forever and always Paterson, #NorthJersey and myself will be thankful for Congressman Bill Pascrell Jr. He was a leader amongst leaders. A voice for the unheard. And a pillar of #NewJersey in his own right. https://t.co/5ygNzghdIZ https://t.co/0kQm6UDlps

Today in #Paterson, we celebrated a major milestone: the unveiling of Congressman Bill Pascrell, Jr. Way. It is the new name for the street right in front of where the Congressman lived most of his life. https://t.co/BgPzjtdAyU

We had a great time over in @Lodi_NewJersey for the Fall Festival 🍂

This year, we celebrated the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame legend Eddie Brigati and his #BergenCounty roots! https://t.co/6UV2RgQ7ym

October is #DomesticViolenceAwarenessMonth where we stand in solidarity with the survivors of such heinous acts. 

Behind every statistic is someone who deserves to feel secure. I will never stop fighting for the safety and dignity of all survivors as they work to rebuild their lives💜
Thank you for coming 🫶🏻 https://t.co/pqBm5hRouu

From #Paterson's Great Falls to our small businesses in #Passaic, it was good to show the beauty of our home and hear directly from our community on the issues that matter most. Thank you, Pete, for coming to the Garden State! https://t.co/PSCs0dysBL https://t.co/BzsjIfxqaH
#NJ09 had the opportunity to host California's very own @RepPeteAguilar, the highest-ranking Latino in Congress who is fighting for communities across the nation. https://t.co/4RAxiNYyuQ

Federal investment helped turn a dream into reality for our #Paterson community. My predecessor, Congressman Bill Pascrell, helped make the renovated Westside Park possible.

Like Bill, I will never stop bringing federal resources home for our community: https://t.co/zdiKTy17kY

Over 130 years ago, Westside Park in #Paterson was created as a place of beauty and joy. Now, we are giving it new life 🛝🌳

Federal investment helped turn planning and promises into something that children and families will enjoy for years to come. I will never stop bringing the resources home for our community to prosper.

More than a month later, questions still remain over the missing oil, potential environmental damage, and cleanup efforts after the major diesel spill in #Secaucus.

Our community needs answers. I will not stop demanding transparency so that we know what's happening at home. https://t.co/cgxvcLydO9
I am beyond happy to see their newly renovated space come to life and be ready to serve our #Paterson community. https://t.co/z8BgYRhbPO https://t.co/p6o3qY1BbO

Hard times can look like a variety of different situations, and that includes facing hunger. 

The Father English Food Pantry -- operated by @CCharitiesPat -- understands what it means to treat all people with dignity, including those who may have less. (1/2) https://t.co/t51EgDOLA1

It was so good to join #BergenCounty in raising the flag and celebrating #ItalianAmericanHeritageMonth. Here in #NorthJersey, generations of Italian Americans have helped shape the identity and character of our communities 🇮🇹

Viva l’Italia! https://t.co/GWOFIQkKjG

#NJ09 is home to one of the largest Peruvian communities in the country -- cutting the route between Newark Airport and Lima will disrupt countless of families and travelers.

I am urging @united to maintain this vital path: https://t.co/I7gg1QHUUh

Our seniors built our communities and cared for us when we needed them. Now, it is our duty to return the favor. 

So good to join the groundbreaking of the new multigenerational care center coming to #BergenCounty

READ: https://t.co/OeMs70V2oM

Thank you to every person - from our children to our seniors - who attended this special night. The contributions of all of you are what make our community a home ❤️  

¡Que viva nuestra comunidad latina! https://t.co/jDTtHXfVHi https://t.co/Re2ds5Lnp7

This week marked the end of #HispanicHeritageMonth, and I celebrated with our #NorthJersey community! 

We had Martin and Gabriela Soto who I have been proud to advocate for, vibrant song and dance performances, and genuine friendship, camaraderie, and unity. (1/2) https://t.co/LYax0PMFWu

Under the cover of night, #Trump has once again betrayed our Ukrainian partners. We knew the President would exempt Russia under a toothless sanctions law and he did exactly that. Aiding Putin’s illegal and aggressive war is unacceptable. https://t.co/fAUeX9Wqth

When @NJCDC opened the Great Falls Youth Center eight years ago, none of us knew just how much it would grow.

But our young people came, finding a place where they felt welcomed. It was so good to be in #Paterson to break ground on a new facility that will extend the impact of the Youth Center.

This week in #Edgewater, I joined the family of Lieutenant Colonel Armen Pohan to replace several of his honors that were tragically lost in a house fire.

Lieutenant Colonel Pohan sacrificed his life for our freedom and security during #WWII. For that, we must never let his story disappear – not from our memories or our hearts.

A strong partnership between pilots & air traffic controllers keeps countless lives safe. When controllers come back to the cockpit, we need to make sure they stay there. 

Proud the FAA has used my FLIGHT DECK bill to achieve this. READ: https://t.co/oZg3S6xSvT

Though #HispanicHeritageMonth may be coming to an end, my appreciation for the diverse communities that contribute to #NJ09 does not stop.

It was good to be with the #RochellePark community and celebrate Hispanic Heritage Month. https://t.co/EeZm5zQFH0

#Secaucus residents deserve answers and transparency. I will not stop pushing for a full accounting of what happened and what clean up efforts are taking place.

READ: https://t.co/Is4gR940pd

Being the first Latina to represent New Jersey in Congress is the greatest honor of my life. It was so good to be with @LatinaCivicFdn to celebrate the incredible Latinas who did not wait for permission to lead.

https://t.co/ELx6uJP5ND
READ: https://t.co/2IRE7msz7K https://t.co/0G3V4uRlfm

It has been over a month since the major oil spill in #Secaucus, and our community still has questions.

Although approximately 4,000 gallons of the spilled diesel has been recovered, we still need a full report on the whereabouts of the remaining fuel and what cleanup efforts look like.

I am also here to help! Visit my website if you need assistance managing federal agencies: https://t.co/pGAOdtCjEC 

(2/2) https://t.co/TOOo1Wj1jz

If you've ever felt like navigating government agencies is difficult, you're not alone. 

That's why here in #PassaicCounty, we're breaking ground on a new facility that will consolidate several government departments under one roof 🪏  (1/2) https://t.co/DZJezxRvnQ

Our government should be making lives easier, not sending residents on what can sometimes feel like a wild goose chase. 

Great to be with #PassaicCounty to break ground on this facility and help make sure community resources are more accessible to all.
 
READ: https://t.co/F964XolxTM

October marks #ItalianAmericanHeritageMonth, a time to recognize and celebrate the contributions, culture, and traditions of Italian Americans across #NewJersey and the nation 🇮🇹 https://t.co/7Z572zIwmW

I am here in #Paterson to celebrate the culture and significance of the Egyptian American community in #NewJersey.

When we raise Egypt's flag, we honor a remarkable nation and the families whose heritage have become part of our American story 🇪🇬🇺🇸 https://t.co/kwCz455HbH

Being the first Latina to represent New Jersey in Congress is the greatest honor of my life. I want our young girls to grow up seeing themselves in positions of leadership and strength, and I want them to know that they too can make a difference. (2/2)

#HispanicHeritageMonth https://t.co/vElTrNUbWy https://t.co/2sGluyKSWS
